investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser/JS execution) against the venue's own official '/agenda/' page, two of its own per-event detail pages (/evenement/{slug}/), and its own '/infos-pratiques/' page. The venue's own JSON-LD (Yoast SEO) on every page is WebPage/BreadcrumbList/Organization/WebSite schema only, never an Event node — the real event data lives in a static grid of <article class="c-tile"> cards, each carrying a machine-readable 'data-categories' attribute (including its own 'YYYY-MM' tag) alongside a human-readable, year-less visible date.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the venue's official '/agenda/' page immediately exposed 58 real, current, dated event cards in static HTML — no calendar plugin or JSON-LD Event node, but every card's own 'data-categories' attribute directly states a machine-readable 'YYYY-MM' tag alongside a human-readable day/month-name date, and every card links to its own per-event detail page which itself states an explicit local start/end time and (for most sampled events) a starting price. No further escalation was needed; Level 1 fully answered the investigation question.

venue_reference: La Bellevilloise (multi-room concert hall, club and cultural venue), 19-21 rue Boyer, 75020 Paris

identity.notes: The retained agenda page's own og:title reads 'Agenda - La Bellevilloise - Club et concerts - Programmation' at the venue's own self-hosted domain labellevilloise.com. The retained '/infos-pratiques/' page directly states 'Adresse : 19-21 rue Boyer, 75020 Paris', matching this task's assigned address exactly — a self-consistent, first-party retained artifact.

site_classification.platform: WordPress (custom theme; no calendar/events plugin, no JSON-LD Event node — the page's own JSON-LD is Yoast SEO's generic WebPage/BreadcrumbList/Organization/WebSite schema only). The agenda page's static HTML directly embeds every currently-listed event as one <article class="c-tile"> card each, spanning August 2026 through December 2026 in the 58 cards retained.

title.notes: Each card's own <span class="c-tile_title"><strong> text states its title directly; each event's own detail page repeats it in an <h1>.

start_date.notes: Each card's own visible 'c-tile_date' text ('Mer 2 septembre') never repeats the year, but the SAME card's own 'data-categories' attribute directly states 'concert;club;2026-09' — its own 'YYYY-MM' tag. Combining these two retained, first-party pieces of the SAME card (not merely a page-level heading, an even stronger case than the canonical policy example) via a fixed, reproducible rule (data-categories' own YYYY-MM supplies year+month; the visible date's own day number supplies the day; the French month name is cross-checked against data-categories' own month number and must agree, or the card is rejected rather than guessed) yields the exact date and nothing else. Verified reproducible, not merely asserted, across all 58 sampled cards spanning August-December 2026 with zero disagreement between the two fields on any card (see the offline proof test). Independently corroborated (not required for PROVEN, but retained as extra confirmation) by this sampled event's own detail-page meta description, which states the full date directly: 'poliça sera en concert à La Bellevilloise le 2 septembre 2026.'

derivation.rule: the nearest data-categories tag matching ^\d{4}-\d{2}$ on the SAME card supplies year+month; the card's own visible c-tile_date text supplies the day number; the visible date's own French month name must name-match data-categories' own month number, or no date is derived

time.notes: Each event's own detail page states an explicit local start/end time range directly in its own <h3 class="c-heading -h2"> block (e.g. 'Mer 2 septembre 20h00 à 22h00'), stated fully and unambiguously. Confirmed consistent in shape (though a different value) on a second sampled event (Symptômes Négatifs: '19h00 à 00h30'). No timezone/offset is stated anywhere on this source — floating local, never upgraded to a UTC instant.

end.notes: The same detail-page time range directly states an end time alongside the start time (see 'time' above) — not a separate field, but the same directly-stated range.

venue_location.notes: The retained '/infos-pratiques/' page directly states 'Adresse : 19-21 rue Boyer, 75020 Paris'; single-venue source, resolved by source_id (venue_name is set to 'La Bellevilloise' as an override, since individual event cards/detail pages state only a room name, e.g. 'Le Club'/'Le Forum', not the venue's own name).

source_record_id.notes: No numeric ID is exposed; each event's own WordPress permalink slug (e.g. 'https://labellevilloise.com/evenement/polica/') is used as source_record_id, the same documented judgement already established for badehaus-berlin/glazart-paris (own URL-slug permalink).

event_url.notes: Each card's own final <a href="..." class="c-link"> is this source's own permanent per-event page URL, stated directly.

price.notes: Not present on the list page itself. One sampled event's own detail page states an explicit starting price directly ('À partir de 13€' for Symptômes Négatifs); another sampled event's own detail page (Poliça, ticketed externally via AEG Presents) states no price at all, only a 'Réserver' link. Genuinely inconsistent across events on this source — present for some, absent for others — so recorded PARTIAL rather than PROVEN across the whole source.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from a self-consistent retained artifact (page og:title, /infos-pratiques/ page's own stated address matching the task's assigned address).
